why: The C# corrective/helper driver's parity fixture (P1 F): rig_drive.drive on sampled poses of the published B.

girdle.why: Scapulohumeral rhythm: past ~30 deg of arm elevation about 1 deg of scapular upward rotation per 2 of the humerus (capped at 60), the clavicle up 16 deg by overhead (a smoothstep over 30..180), the scapula gliding forward 15 mm as the arm goes from hanging to forward; all relative to the rest (MakeHuman's A-pose, 43 deg), so the rest is neutral and a hanging arm turns the blade back down.

helpers.name: delt_{s}
helpers.why: the deltoid bunches (wider across, shorter along) as the arm rises

helpers.name: pec_{s}
helpers.why: the front axillary fold follows the arm

helpers.name: lat_{s}
helpers.why: the back of the armpit follows the arm

helpers.name: glute_{s}
helpers.why: the glute's lower edge follows the thigh as it flexes (the fold rides with it)
